key.name: active
key.description: When false, the extension is loaded but does not change the wallpaper on a schedule. "Change now" from the panel menu still works as a one-shot action regardless of this setting.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: When off, the wallpaper icon is hidden from the top panel. The extension still runs; open preferences via the Extensions app or `gnome-extensions prefs vesper@nvimer.org`.

key.name: local-folder-dark
key.summary: Local wallpaper folder for the dark variant
key.description: Only used when source-type=local and follow-color-scheme=true. Empty means the manager writes a single image to both picture-uri keys.

key.name: switch-mode
key.summary: How to pick the next image (local source only)

key.name: follow-color-scheme
key.summary: Use a different wallpaper for the dark color scheme
key.description: Only effective when source-type=local AND local-folder-dark is set. Remote sources cannot guarantee a dark-toned image, so this toggle is ignored for them.

key.name: wallhaven-purity
key.description: NSFW (3rd bit) is only honored by the server when a valid API key is set.

key.name: wallhaven-api-key
key.description: Required only for NSFW search results. Get one at https://wallhaven.cc/settings/account. Stored in dconf as plain text.

key.name: bing-market
key.summary: Bing market code (en-US, zh-CN, de-DE, ja-JP, ...)
key.description: Bing serves a different daily image per market. See https://www.bing.com/HPImageArchive.aspx for the upstream endpoint.

key.name: nasa-api-key
key.description: If empty, the public DEMO_KEY is used (30 requests/hour shared). Register at https://api.nasa.gov/ to get your own key (1000/hour).

key.name: cache-max-mb
key.summary: Maximum disk space for downloaded wallpapers (MB)
key.description: The cache directory is pruned to stay below this size, oldest files first.

key.name: last-applied-uri-light
key.summary: URI of the last applied wallpaper for the light variant (internal)

key.name: last-applied-uri-dark
key.summary: URI of the last applied wallpaper for the dark variant (internal)

key.name: original-uri
key.description: Captured the first time the user enables rotation. Restored to picture-uri when rotation is disabled or the extension unloads. Empty means nothing to restore.
